models_evaluated: deep learning algorithm on baseline Spectralis OCT

links.outcome: AI versus ophthalmologists on GA progression prediction accuracy, kappa, and c-index on the same eyes
links.effect: Humans: accuracy 0.37-0.43, κ 0.06-0.18, c-index 0.59-0.62. AI (OCT only): accuracy 0.48, κ 0.23, c-index 0.69.
links.quote: Automated AI-based analysis reached an accuracy of 0.48 and κ of 0.23 on the first task, and c-index of 0.69 on the second task solely utilizing OCT imaging.

screen.reason: The study is a reader study comparing ophthalmologists' predictive accuracy against an automated deep learning model predicting progression of geographic atrophy, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
